retention.note: Fresh measurements on 2026-10-04, using the permanent production-default and job-cap cases. All samples, summaries, process timings, RSS, exit codes and build fingerprints retained. Repeated stdout and empty stderr removed only after checking each sample against successful probe output. Executable paths reduced to names and hostname removed. The runner checkout is dirty because corpus and validation fixes are uncommitted; executable provenance is recorded separately in build fingerprints, including the complete 64 KiB control patch. Local backend directories are on the reported ZFS filesystem, not tmpfs.
